description: Ingests an array of raw food items, looks up their elemental values, and translates them into Spirit (Fire), Essence (Water), Matter (Earth), and Substance (Air) ratios, calculating overall thermodynamic metrics and alchemical harmony. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

ingredients.description: List of ingredients in the pantry/fridge (e.g. ['tomato', 'basil', 'garlic'])

name: alchemize_ingredients
